name: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics — Population and Housing Census 2022: District Reports, Community Reports (Table C-01) and Union Statistics, Mymensingh Division
organization: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS), Statistics and Informatics Division, Ministry of Planning
attribution: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics, Population and Housing Census 2022
notes: Population/households are final ENUMERATED counts (census moment 00:00 15 June 2022, incl. floating population), not PEC-adjusted. Unit lists and population per district/upazila/city corporation/thana/paurashava/union/ward from the Community Report Excel files, sheet C-01 (Mymensingh's workbook names it 'C_01'; BBS 2022 geocodes; code_scheme BBS_GEOCODE_2022 = C-01 code columns joined with '-', prefixed by division 45). City-corporation units carry the city-corporation code in the geocode, so the 33 wards and 332 mahallas of Mymensingh City Corporation (45-61-40, one metro thana: Mymensingh Sadar Thana 45-61-40-52) are kept apart from paurashava wards and from Mymensingh Sadar upazila (45-61-52). Administrative-unit counts, area and density from the District Report Key Findings tables (District Series, 2024) and Union Statistics (June 2025) Table D01. basis: enumerated | as stated (printed in a BBS table) | derived (counted from the C-01 geocode rows). One non-union unit is printed in the Union/Ward column: 'Cantonment' (45-61-40-52-998, inside the city-corporation thana), kept at level cantonment, not counted as a ward or union. No forest (997) row; char unions ('Char ...', '...char') are ordinary union parishads and stay at level union. Community Report labels on the BBS page: MYMENSINGH, JAMALPUR, SHERPUR, NETRAKONA (output name Netrokona; C-01 and D01 print 'Netrakona'). Large PDFs/Excel are not committed; fetch.py --division mymensingh re-downloads them (bbs.gov.bd needs the Sectigo DV R36 intermediate, added at runtime from its AIA URL).
